what: The formerly transparent section background fills with one color tied to the scroll — 0 the moment the section’s top edge touches the bottom of the screen, then 1 after scrolling further by (window height − header height + 450px, or 200px when the window width is under 1008px). The moment the intensity passes .5, the text (title·lead) flips to the background color so it reads on the darkened background. No curve, 1:1 with the scroll, and touch screens use .8× the intensity.

options.color: Fill color (css value or variable), default var(--kf-accent)
options.room: Extra distance until full (px), default 450 — narrow screens use room-sp (default 200)
options.head: Selector for the element whose height is subtracted (header), default none (0)
options.--fx-flip-ink: Flipped text color (css variable), default var(--kf-bg)
options.[data-fx-part=flip]: Text that changes color once its intensity passes flip (whole section text if none)

from.where: index.js·index.css .team (expert team section — transparent → blue, text turns beige halfway)
